summary: VisionWave Holdings filed an 8-K disclosing the October 12, 2026 termination of its September 30, 2026 Joint Venture and Operating Agreement with Sadot Group and CMJV LLC, unwinding the CM Composite Materials transaction except for 250,000 Sadot Entry Premium Shares retained by VisionWave. The JV had issued 7,814,323 membership units each to VisionWave and Sadot, with Sadot committing up to $7,814,323 of capital. Termination stemmed from CMJV's failure to deliver required IFRS or US GAAP financial statements for CM. Watch for whether VisionWave monetizes or writes down the retained Sadot shares and any related 3.02 unregistered sales detail.
